==Background==
"'''Yoka ni Mitorete'''" is an original song produced by keeno. It was commissioned for the unit {{IW|projectsekai|25-ji, Nightcord de.}} from the video game ''{{IW|projectsekai|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE!|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE! feat. Hatsune Miku}}''.

The VOCALOID version of the song, sung by Hatsune Miku, was originally exclusive to the game but later received an MV over a year after the song's inclusion.

The 25-ji, Nightcord de. version has exceeded 7 million views on YouTube and has entered the ''[[Hall of Fame]]''.

==Other media appearances==
===Discography===
The 25-ji, Nightcord de. version of the this song was featured on the single ''余花にみとれて / D/N/A (Yoka ni Mitorete / D/N/A)''.

===Video games===
This song was featured in the video game ''{{IW|projectsekai|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE!|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE! feat. Hatsune Miku}}'' (Virtual Singer version by Hatsune Miku; SEKAI version by 25-ji, Nightcord de. and MEIKO).
